historical_native_excel_evidence.basis: Historical signed Gate D evidence only; no fresh native Excel checks

limitations: Measured evidence requires independent release review; not Gate E sign-off or CV-ready wording.
Assigned-country customer scopes differ from transaction-country financial filters.
Observed credits are not confirmed physical returns; net value is not profit or predicted lifetime value.
Full-window RFM is descriptive, not prospective; no intervention effect is measured.
Source-start exclusion does not eliminate left censoring; below-minimum cells remain visible.
Sensitivity uses session-local temporary tables only; no persistent database writes.

cohort_checks.migration_provenance: customer_snapshot; segment assignments require separate raw validation

scoring_checks.reference_provenance: Independent Python rescoring and aggregation of the separately raw-validated frozen customer snapshot

exposure_checks.basis: Previously raw-validated customer tables; independent Python aggregate crosscheck

    CAST(invoice_at AS DATE) AS invoice_date,
    CAST(date_trunc('month', invoice_at) AS DATE) AS month
    FROM prepared_lines WHERE inclusion_state = 'included'), expected AS (
                SELECT invoice_token, customer_state, customer_id, country, invoice_date, count(*) AS line_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE line_class = 'positive_merchandise') AS positive_line_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE line_class = 'recorded_credit') AS credit_line_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE line_class NOT IN ('positive_merchandise', 'recorded_credit')) AS excluded_line_count, sum(signed_amount) AS signed_amount, sum(CASE WHEN line_class = 'positive_merchandise' THEN signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_gbp, -sum(CASE WHEN line_class = 'recorded_credit' THEN signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_magnitude_gbp, sum(CASE WHEN line_class IN ('positive_merchandise', 'recorded_credit') THEN signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_gbp, sum(CASE WHEN line_class NOT IN ('positive_merchandise', 'recorded_credit') THEN signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_signed_gbp, count(DISTINCT invoice_token) FILTER (WHERE line_class = 'positive_merchandise') AS positive_invoice_count FROM lines GROUP BY invoice_token, customer_state, customer_id, country, invoice_date

                (SELECT invoice_token, customer_state, customer_id, country, invoice_date, line_count, positive_line_count, credit_line_count, excluded_line_count, signed_amount, gross_gbp, credit_magnitude_gbp, net_gbp, excluded_signed_gbp, positive_invoice_count FROM expected EXCEPT ALL SELECT invoice_token, customer_state, customer_id, country, invoice_date, line_count, positive_line_count, credit_line_count, excluded_line_count, signed_amount, gross_gbp, credit_magnitude_gbp, net_gbp, excluded_signed_gbp, positive_invoice_count FROM invoice_summary)

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sensitivity_customers AS
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT p.scenario, p.multiplier, s.customer_id, s.assigned_country,
        5 - len(list_filter(list_transform($recency_bounds, lambda x: x * p.multiplier), lambda x: s.recency_days > x)) AS r_score,
        1 + len(list_filter(list_transform($frequency_bounds, lambda x: x * p.multiplier), lambda x: s.frequency > x)) AS f_score,
        1 + len(list_filter(list_transform($monetary_bounds, lambda x: x * p.multiplier), lambda x: s.gross_gbp > x)) AS gross_m_score,
        1 + len(list_filter(list_transform($monetary_bounds, lambda x: x * p.multiplier), lambda x: s.net_gbp > x)) AS net_m_score,
        s.gross_segment AS base_gross_segment, s.net_segment AS base_net_segment,
        s.gross_gbp, s.credit_magnitude_gbp, s.net_gbp, s.gross_rank, s.net_rank
    FROM customer_snapshot s CROSS JOIN sensitivity_parameters p
    WHERE s.eligibility_state = 'purchase_history'
)
SELECT scenario, multiplier, customer_id, assigned_country, r_score, f_score,
    gross_m_score, net_m_score,
    CASE WHEN r_score + f_score + gross_m_score >= $higher_score THEN 'Higher RFM'
         WHEN r_score + f_score + gross_m_score >= $middle_score THEN 'Middle RFM'
         ELSE 'Lower RFM' END AS gross_segment,
    CASE WHEN r_score + f_score + net_m_score >= $higher_score THEN 'Higher RFM'
         WHEN r_score + f_score + net_m_score >= $middle_score THEN 'Middle RFM'
         ELSE 'Lower RFM' END AS net_segment,
    base_gross_segment, base_net_segment, gross_gbp, credit_magnitude_gbp, net_gbp,
    gross_rank, net_rank
FROM scored;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sensitivity_summary AS
SELECT c.scope, p.scenario, p.multiplier, count(s.customer_id) AS purchase_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.gross_m_score <> s.net_m_score) AS monetary_score_changed_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.gross_segment <> s.net_segment) AS segment_changed_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.gross_segment = 'Higher RFM' AND s.net_segment <> 'Higher RFM') AS higher_segment_exits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.gross_segment <> s.base_gross_segment) AS gross_label_changes_vs_base,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.net_segment <> s.base_net_segment) AS net_label_changes_vs_base,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.net_gbp < 0) AS negative_net_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.net_rank > s.gross_rank) AS net_rank_worsened_customers,
    coalesce(sum(s.gross_gbp),0) AS gross_gbp,
    coalesce(sum(s.credit_magnitude_gbp),0) AS credit_magnitude_gbp,
    coalesce(sum(s.net_gbp),0) AS net_gbp,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.gross_segment <> s.net_segment)::DOUBLE / nullif(count(s.customer_id),0) AS segment_changed_share
FROM sensitivity_scopes c CROSS JOIN sensitivity_parameters p
LEFT JOIN sensitivity_scoped s ON s.scope = c.scope AND s.scenario = p.scenario
GROUP BY c.scope, p.scenario, p.multiplier;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sensitivity_migration AS
WITH cells AS (
    SELECT c.scope, p.scenario, p.multiplier, g.segment AS gross_segment,
        n.segment AS net_segment, count(s.customer_id) AS customers,
        coalesce(sum(s.gross_gbp),0) AS gross_gbp,
        coalesce(sum(s.credit_magnitude_gbp),0) AS credit_magnitude_gbp,
        coalesce(sum(s.net_gbp),0) AS net_gbp
    FROM sensitivity_scopes c CROSS JOIN sensitivity_parameters p
    CROSS JOIN sensitivity_segments g CROSS JOIN sensitivity_segments n
    LEFT JOIN sensitivity_scoped s ON s.scope = c.scope AND s.scenario = p.scenario
        AND s.gross_segment = g.segment AND s.net_segment = n.segment
    GROUP BY c.scope, p.scenario, p.multiplier, g.segment, n.segment
), denominators AS (
    SELECT *, sum(customers) OVER (PARTITION BY scope, scenario, gross_segment) AS gross_segment_customers
    FROM cells
)
SELECT d.scope, d.scenario, d.multiplier, v.minimum_customers, d.gross_segment, d.net_segment,
    d.customers, d.gross_segment_customers,
    d.customers::DOUBLE / nullif(d.gross_segment_customers,0) AS gross_row_share,
    CASE WHEN d.customers = 0 THEN 'empty'
         WHEN d.customers >= v.minimum_customers THEN 'meets_minimum'
         ELSE 'below_minimum' END AS review_state,
    d.gross_gbp, d.credit_magnitude_gbp, d.net_gbp
FROM denominators d CROSS JOIN sensitivity_minimums v;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sensitivity_stability AS
WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT scope, customer_id,
        min(CASE WHEN gross_segment <> net_segment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS always_moved,
        max(CASE WHEN gross_segment <> net_segment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_moved,
        count(DISTINCT gross_segment) > 1 AS gross_sensitive,
        count(DISTINCT net_segment) > 1 AS net_sensitive
    FROM sensitivity_scoped GROUP BY scope, customer_id
)
SELECT c.scope, count(p.customer_id) AS purchase_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.always_moved = 1) AS always_moved,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.ever_moved = 0) AS never_moved,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.always_moved <> p.ever_moved) AS movement_sensitive,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.gross_sensitive) AS gross_label_sensitive,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.net_sensitive) AS net_label_sensitive
FROM sensitivity_scopes c LEFT JOIN per_customer p ON p.scope = c.scope GROUP BY c.scope;

WITH invoice_flags AS (
    SELECT customer_id, bool_or(purchase_at != last_line_at) AS multi_timestamp
    FROM positive_invoices GROUP BY customer_id
), base AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.assigned_country, f.cohort_month,
        f.followup_state = 'complete' AS complete, coalesce(f.repeated_90d, false) AS repeated,
        f.first_timestamp_invoice_count > 1 AS simultaneous, i.multi_timestamp,
        s.frequency, date_diff('day', CAST(s.first_purchase_at AS DATE), $reference) AS observed_days
    FROM customer_snapshot s JOIN customer_followup f USING (customer_id)
    JOIN invoice_flags i USING (customer_id) WHERE s.eligibility_state = 'purchase_history'
), scoped AS (
    SELECT scopes.scope, b.* FROM base b
    JOIN (VALUES ('ALL'), ('United Kingdom'), ('France')) scopes(scope)
    ON scopes.scope = 'ALL' OR scopes.scope = b.assigned_country
), marked AS (
    SELECT *, bool_and(complete) OVER (PARTITION BY scope, cohort_month) AS complete_cohort
    FROM scoped
), policies AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('all_eligible'), ('exclude_source_start_cohort'),
        ('exclude_simultaneous_first'), ('exclude_multi_timestamp_customers'),
        ('exclude_any_invoice_ambiguity'), ('complete_cohorts_only')) p(policy)
), groups AS (
    SELECT 'cohorts' AS kind, scope, CAST(cohort_month AS VARCHAR) AS label, * EXCLUDE(scope)
    FROM marked
    UNION ALL BY NAME
    SELECT 'exposure' AS kind, scope, CAST(year(cohort_month) AS VARCHAR) AS label, * EXCLUDE(scope)
    FROM marked
    UNION ALL BY NAME
    SELECT 'repeat_sensitivity' AS kind, scope, policy AS label, m.* EXCLUDE(scope)
    FROM marked m CROSS JOIN policies
    WHERE policy = 'all_eligible'
       OR (policy = 'exclude_source_start_cohort' AND cohort_month != $source_month)
       OR (policy = 'exclude_simultaneous_first' AND NOT simultaneous)
       OR (policy = 'exclude_multi_timestamp_customers' AND NOT multi_timestamp)
       OR (policy = 'exclude_any_invoice_ambiguity' AND NOT simultaneous AND NOT multi_timestamp)
       OR (policy = 'complete_cohorts_only' AND complete_cohort)
)
SELECT kind, scope, label, count(*) AS observed_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE complete) AS complete_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT complete) AS incomplete_customers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE complete AND repeated) AS repeat_customers,
    sum(frequency) AS positive_invoice_count, min(observed_days) AS observed_days_min,
    max(observed_days) AS observed_days_max
FROM groups GROUP BY kind, scope, label ORDER BY kind, scope, label;
